brief: Opening bleed still — motion in the window of the plate, not through the page.
subject: opening-bleed

takes.name: Current Ken Burns
takes.thesis: The plate eases 1.0→1.06 over ~18s on .vega-hero-still; grain sits on the frame; reduced-motion holds the still.

takes.name: Hold-on-breath
takes.thesis: The photograph is frozen. Only grain, caption, and type are allowed to live.

takes.name: Boxed Ken Burns
takes.thesis: The same slow push, but it happens inside an inset plate — not the full bleed.

takes.name: Two-still crossfade
takes.thesis: Estoril and the lookout trade on a ~20s timer. No scroll, no Ken Burns.

takes.name: Crop-as-composition
takes.thesis: The frame stays put. object-position cuts to a new crop on a stepped cycle — not mouse, not parallax.

takes.name: Letterbox
takes.thesis: A still photograph in a cinematic matte. No push, no fade, no crop walk.
